recommendation: Keep the fix as-is; it applies the final same-family decision to active Claim conformance source without adding an obsolete backbone.
issue_request: FHIR-7318 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Claim and requested priority order for diagnosisLinkId values at a line item; its recorded resolution proposed replacing the primitive repeated link id with a diagnosis backbone containing linkId and sequence.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-7318-tagged source commit was found. Historical Claim source retained a repeated diagnosis pointer, later renamed from diagnosisLinkId to diagnosisSequence, but current Claim.item.diagnosisSequence lacked any item-level order meaning.
additional_context: FHIR-7317, a later same-family Published/Persuasive with Modification issue, narrowed the approach to ordered diagnosisLinkId lists for Claim and EOB rather than a new backbone. FHIR-7319 clarifies that diagnosis.sequence is only a local reference identifier and diagnosis.type carries global primary/secondary roles, so item-specific pointer order is compatible with the current model.
reconciliation: Added an orderMeaning value to source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml for Claim.item.diagnosisSequence. Claim is active in source/fhir.ini and the old diagnosisLinkId name maps to diagnosisSequence.
source_changes: source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml: added orderMeaning to Claim.item.diagnosisSequence: diagnosis sequences are listed in order of decreasing relevance to the service or product.

related_jiras.note: Later modified resolution for the same diagnosisLinkId ordering issue; used to narrow the current fix to ordered repeated lists and decided opportunistically for EOB.
Clarifies that diagnosis.sequence is not global diagnosis ranking and diagnosis.type carries primary/secondary roles.
